import gdb,struct
p=gdb.selected_inferior();thread=next(t for t in p.threads() if t.ptid[1]==81);thread.switch();fp=int(gdb.parse_and_eval('$rbp'))
for i in range(4):
 prior,pc=struct.unpack('<QQ',p.read_memory(fp,16).tobytes());print('FP',i,hex(fp),'return',hex(pc))
 if i==3:
  ctxt=fp+16;raw=p.read_memory(ctxt,256).tobytes();regs=struct.unpack_from('<23Q',raw,40);print('CONTEXT',hex(ctxt));print('REGISTERS',dict(zip(['r8','r9','r10','r11','r12','r13','r14','r15','rdi','rsi','rbp','rbx','rdx','rax','rcx','rsp','rip','efl','segments','err','trapno','oldmask','cr2'],[hex(x) for x in regs])));print('PC',hex(regs[16]));print('FRAME',0,hex(regs[16]));print('ORIGINAL_STACK',p.read_memory(regs[15],64).tobytes().hex())
 fp=prior
